quote: The driver of a vehicle shall not follow another vehicle more closely than is reasonable and prudent, having due regard for the speed of such vehicles and the traffic upon and the condition of the highway.

activation.source_clause: The driver of a vehicle shall not follow another vehicle
activation.description: An original ego driver follows a separate, moving lead vehicle in the same lane.

obligation.source_clause: more closely than is reasonable and prudent
obligation.description: Preserve the open-textured following distance judgment without a numerical legal cutoff.

timing.description: Assess the continuous original following interval; the statute supplies no fixed duration.

judgment_calls_needed.note: No statutory numeric gap or headway cutoff; judge original following conduct in context.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: having due regard for the speed of such vehicles and the traffic upon and the condition of the highway
judgment_calls_needed.note: Both measured speeds, surrounding traffic and highway condition require separate original-source review.
